description: Desktop tool that rescues files from a Yandex.Disk that stopped serving them. Builds an inventory with hashes even for files that can no longer be downloaded, probes availability by fetching the first and last byte, downloads into .part and verifies md5/sha256 before renaming, re-checks unavailable files in rounds, packs into 7z volumes sized for Telegram, and deletes from the cloud only after a verified copy. Inventory lists folders concurrently and skips unchanged folders previously confirmed empty; full scan can be requested. Windows only: the OAuth token is kept in a DPAPI-protected file.
rules: Windows only: the token lives in %LOCALAPPDATA%\Drydock\credentials.bin encrypted with DPAPI for the current user; it cannot be moved to another machine.
Cloud deletion supports verified downloads, verified archives, and explicit manual selection. Deletion based only on an unavailable/504 probe is disabled because availability can recover.
The loop rebuilds its queue on every pass: rescued files drop out, a file that just failed is set aside for LOOP_COOLDOWN_MIN minutes, a fresh 404 is re-checked once a day (GONE_RECHECK_S).
A full disk stops the loop: when free space drops below RESERVE, the download returns no_space instead of spinning.
Job progress and API errors travel as codes, not prose: {"c": "loop.saved", ...} for jobs, {"code": "err.noToken"} for HTTP errors; the interface translates them into six languages.
Interface strings are not edited in web/i18n/*.json: run tools/make_i18n.py, and tools/make_i18n.py --check verifies the dictionaries match the code.
